name: Observium Docker
what_it_is: Containerized Observium Community Edition 24.12 network monitoring platform with MariaDB, Apache/PHP, Smokeping latency monitoring, and Ofelia-based job scheduling. Configuration is entirely environment-variable driven, automatically translated to PHP config at startup.
components: httpd (Apache + PHP 8.2, Observium web UI and backend)
smokeping (latency monitoring with auto-generated Targets config)
protocols: SNMP v2c (default device polling via snmp-devices.txt import)
SNMP v3 (supported by Observium for device discovery and polling)
WMI (Windows Management Instrumentation for Windows hosts)
CDP (Cisco Discovery Protocol for topology mapping)
LLDP (Link Layer Discovery Protocol for topology mapping)
measurement: SNMP polling every 5 minutes (all devices via observium-wrapper poller)
Device discovery every 5 minutes for new devices, full rediscovery every 6 hours
Smokeping latency RRD data stored in smokeping-data volume
Observium RRD graph data stored in observium-rrd volume
Daily database and RRD backups retained for last 10 cycles
Health check on httpd via TCP probe to port 8080 every 10 seconds
configuration: OBSERVIUM__ prefix env vars auto-translated to PHP $config[] at startup (supports nested keys via __, dash substitution via ___, indexed arrays via __N)
SNMP device bulk import via observium/conf/snmp-devices.txt (format: hostname|community|version|port|transport|description)
SHOW_GENERATED_CONFIG_DURING_STARTUP=yes logs generated PHP config (exposes secrets)
DEBUG_MODE=false env var enables debug logging
DB_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT configures MariaDB readiness wait (default 60 seconds, up to 3 config-generation retries)
Backup destination mapped via compose.override.yaml volume mount to ./backups:/backup/destination
fault_injection: Database connection failure: set DB_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT=1 or misconfigure DB_PASSWORD to trigger 'Failed to connect to database after N attempts' error path
Race condition simulation: scale httpd to >1 replica to exercise distributed initialization locking (file lock prevents duplicate schema creation)
Config generation failure: provide malformed OBSERVIUM__ vars to trigger 'Failed to generate configuration after 3 attempts' error
Missing required env vars (DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD, DB_NAME, OBSERVIUM_ADMIN_USER, OBSERVIUM_ADMIN_PASSWORD) cause container to exit immediately with ERROR log
modes: Single-node mode (default): all services in one docker compose up
Override mode: compose.override.yaml for custom volume mounts and port exposure
Debug mode: DEBUG_MODE=true + SHOW_GENERATED_CONFIG_DURING_STARTUP=yes for verbose startup logging
Manual device management: add devices post-startup via web UI (Devices > Add Device) or restart httpd to re-trigger snmp-devices.txt import
constraints: Docker Engine 20.10+ and Docker Compose 2.0+ required; does not support legacy docker-compose v1
First startup takes 2-3 minutes for database schema initialization; subsequent starts are faster
Ofelia scheduler requires access to Docker socket (/var/run/docker.sock) mounted read-only
Smokeping Targets config is regenerated every 5 minutes by ofelia; manual edits to /etc/smokeping/config.d/Targets are overwritten
Only the last 10 backups are retained (older ones deleted by trim-backup-* ofelia jobs)
MariaDB stop_grace_period is 45 seconds; forceful shutdown before this may corrupt the database
OBSERVIUM__ env var keys with leading-zero numeric values are kept as strings (e.g., '007') to prevent PHP integer coercion
notable_absences: No HTTPS/TLS termination in-container — reverse proxy required for production HTTPS
No built-in alerting/notification service — email alerts require OBSERVIUM__email__ config vars pointing to external SMTP
No Observium Professional/Enterprise features (syslog, netflow, billing) — Community Edition only
No pre-built Docker image published to registry — requires local build from source
No support for Observium Unix agent installation automation — agent-local/ directory provided but deployment is manual
